about: Happenings at sea and in port (the user's spec: 'Events: text-based, placeholders'). Each is a label, a plain intention, and options whose outcomes are facts; your writing for each key ('event.<id>', 'event.<id>.<option>') goes in writing.json. Once a game day, each event whose conditions hold may come (its chance a day); at most one at a time. Edit freely: conditions, chances, options and effects are all here. Numbers are starting guesses.
effects_help: health / morale: + or - share (0-1); men: + or - men; silver: + or - deniers' worth; goods: {good id: + or - units}; water: + or - litres; spoil_food: share of the food aboard lost; deed: a deed kept (and standing: its kind in reputation_793.json, which moves your standing there); chance: a share, then 'success' and 'failure' (each its own effects); text: the fact shown (with {n} for a number the effect used)
conditions_help: where: sea | port | any; months: [1-12]; min_days_at_sea; health_below / morale_below (0-1); wind_above (m/s); calm (true: wind under 1.5 m/s); fog_above (0-1); has_goods: [ids] (any aboard); port_kinds: [kinds]; regions: [trade regions]; year_from / year_to; cooldown_days (default 20)

events.title: A man falls sick
events.intention: One of the crew has a fever and can't work.

success.text: He mends in a few days.

failure.text: He dies at his oar. One man fewer.

events.title: Becalmed
events.intention: No wind. The sail hangs slack.

events.title: Fog
events.intention: Thick fog. The lookout can't see the bow.

options.label: Sound with the lead and go slow

events.title: Fish
events.intention: A shoal under the boat; the men have lines.

effects.text: A good catch: food for days.

events.title: The men grumble
events.intention: The crew are sore: short of food, pay or rest.

effects.text: A cask of ale for the crew.

options.label: Promise them a bonus in port

effects.text: You promise them a bonus, 6 deniers paid.

events.title: A man asks passage
events.intention: Someone wants carrying to the next port; he'll pay.

effects.text: He pays 8 deniers for his passage.

events.title: Letters to carry
events.intention: A priest asks you to carry letters to a house over the sea.

events.title: Thieves on the jetty
events.intention: Someone has been at the cargo in the night.

success.text: You find the goods and get them back.

failure.text: Nothing found; you've lost 10 deniers' worth.

options.label: Set a watch from now on

effects.text: 10 deniers' worth gone. The men keep watch.

events.title: A dispute at the market
events.intention: A trader says your goods were short weight.

effects.text: You pay 5 deniers to settle it.

success.deed: won a case before the reeve

failure.deed: lost a case before the reeve
failure.text: The reeve finds against you: 12 deniers.
